scope: Separate optional-parameter and direct proof-erasure acceptance behind explicit reusable-workflow inputs, retain the existing weekly subtype lanes without unrelated matrix cost, and expose one already registered proof-erasure workflow as a bounded ten-lane producer. Reconcile twenty canonical ordinary/reviewed reports from seventeen profiles into one exact-run fail-closed receipt. Preserve the existing low-cost audit as the default, retain identical package checkers and artifact prefixes, select the checksummed Perl 5.38.2 threaded toolchain explicitly, and make no support promotion before hosted evidence is retained.

edits.current:
inputs:
      suite:
        description: Bounded direct proof-erasure suite to execute
        required: true
        default: audit
        type: choice
        options:
          - audit
          - produce

npm-browser:
    name: Node and browser producer
    if: inputs.suite == 'produce'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/generic-subtype-npm-browser.yml
    with:
      direct_proof_erasure: true

  native-perl:
    name: Native and Perl producers
    if: inputs.suite == 'produce'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/generic-subtype-native-perl.yml
    with:
      direct_proof_erasure: true

  languages:
    name: Python, Ruby and Rust producers
    if: inputs.suite == 'produce'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/generic-subtype-languages.yml
    with:
      direct_proof_erasure: true

  managed-wit:
    name: Managed and WIT producers
    if: inputs.suite == 'produce'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/generic-subtype-managed-wit.yml
    with:
      direct_proof_erasure: true

  php:
    name: PHP and PHP-Wasm producer
    if: inputs.suite == 'produce'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/nominal-subtype-php-wasm.yml
    with:
      direct_proof_erasure: true

  receipt:
    name: Reconcile the exact same-run receipt
    if: always() && inputs.suite == 'produce'
    needs:
      - npm-browser
      - native-perl
      - languages
      - managed-wit
      - php
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact producer revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Download every same-run direct proof-erasure artifact
        id: download
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          pattern: direct-proof-erasure-*-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/direct-proof-erasure-matrix-input
      - name: Reconcile all seventeen profiles and both author routes
        id: reconciliation
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          node scripts/reconcile-direct-proof-erasure-matrix.mjs \
            --directory build/direct-proof-erasure-matrix-input \
            --output build/direct-proof-erasure-matrix/receipt.json \
            --producer "${{ github.sha }}" \
            --repository "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --workflow ".github/workflows/direct-proof-erasure-complete.yml" \
            --run-id "${{ github.run_id }}" \
            --run-attempt "${{ github.run_attempt }}"
      - name: Preserve the complete direct proof-erasure receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: direct-proof-erasure-matrix-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/direct-proof-erasure-matrix/receipt.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce every producer and exact receipt reconciliation
        if: >-
          always() &&
          (needs.npm-browser.result != 'success' ||
           needs.native-perl.result != 'success' ||
           needs.languages.result != 'success' ||
           needs.managed-wit.result != 'success' ||
           needs.php.result != 'success' ||
           steps.download.outcome != 'success' ||
           steps.reconciliation.outcome != 'success')
        run: exit 1
